SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(ast) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(turnover), 0) AS ast_to_tov_ratio, COUNT(*) AS games_played
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE played = 1 AND game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 AND SUM(turnover) > 0
ORDER BY ast_to_tov_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
